findings.title: Independent review manifest is not associated with its decision or Source bindings
findings.actual: validate_review loads rm but never inspects it: an empty review MF with no decision membership and no Source refs passes. Canonical Root path alias /root also passes actor inequality. The current real v6 review is valid; the negative malformed-packet control exposes a registrar validation gap.
findings.fix: Require review MF decision membership and its exact source_hdf/source_mf associations, bind the canonical designated independent reviewer and original handoff provenance. Caller MF top-level caller_source_ref/contract_ref already seal those two members; no members-array requirement is needed there.

findings.title: Activation has no separate authentic fresh postseal Root context
findings.actual: register binds live_ref to immutable early facts and request; a new postseal ref is rejected. Earlier Source context remains admissible without timestamp/provenance checks, and created_utc accepts null/false/malformed values.
findings.fix: Preserve the early Source context and add a separate authentic fresh postseal Root activation context bound to sealed facts/review and the current original cutoff; verify its timestamp and original Root provenance.

findings.title: Original failure numeric results can be fabricated
findings.actual: Ordinal967 original outer1/Native unobserved can be supplied as outer0/Native0. Only nullable-int shape and origin file pin are verified; original envelope numeric values are not compared.
findings.fix: Extract and bind original observed exits, preserving unknown as null and matching immutable original ordinal/event identity.

findings.title: Original invocation selector and exit qualification are lost
findings.actual: The single invocation966 can be counted again as970 because dedup trusts the supplied ordinal. Exact row schema has no selector or exit_qualification. Root971/972 correctly share one original file with different selectors, which the schema cannot retain.
findings.fix: Preserve and verify origin_selector and exit_qualification, bind immutable original ordinal to that invocation, and deduplicate (origin pin,selector) across existing/pending events. Distinct selectors sharing a file must remain legal.

findings.title: Output root alias admits the whole receipt boundary
findings.actual: W09-99/SYNTHETIC_NOT_CREATED/.. passes OUTPUT_ROOT_SCOPE and normalizes to W09-99 itself.
findings.fix: Canonicalize once, require canonical spelling and a strict child of ROOT_OUTPUT_BOUNDARY, then persist only that bounded canonical output root.

clarifications: The initial controls label for empty caller MF members is a successful valid top-level-ref representation, not a blocker; only the unused independent review MF is defective.
Early Source context may precede Source review; fresh activation context must be a separately bound postseal input.
Distinct invocation selectors within the same original file are legal; deduplicate actual invocation identity, never file-ref alone.
Final Caller v6 availability is now verified and is not a defect. Final Registrar Source acceptance is still not granted.
